title: With Raspberry Pi
description: Master Raspberry Pi with our comprehensive tutorials covering setup, programming, troubleshooting, and advanced projects. Perfect for beginners and experts alike.

items.title: AArch64 ADRP, ADD, ADR, and LDR Literal Explained
items.content_html: Understand AArch64 ADRP plus ADD, ADR, LDR literal, and the LDR equals pseudo-instruction. Includes ranges, relocations, disassembly, and Raspberry Pi examples.

items.title: Raspberry Pi Headless and Networking Guide 2026
items.content_html: Choose the best Raspberry Pi headless connection in 2026. Compare Wi-Fi, Ethernet, USB Gadget, SSH, Connect, Tailscale, VNC, static IP, and recovery paths.

items.title: Raspberry Pi USB Gadget Mode 2026: SSH over USB
items.content_html: Set up Raspberry Pi USB Gadget Mode on Trixie for SSH over one USB cable. Covers Imager, rpi-usb-gadget, supported models, Windows, macOS, Linux, and fixes.

items.title: Compute Module 5 Setup: eMMC, NVMe, and IO Board Guide
items.content_html: Set up Raspberry Pi Compute Module 5 with the IO Board. Compare Lite and eMMC models, expose storage with rpiboot, flash, configure NVMe, and test thermals.

items.title: Raspberry Pi Benchmark Methodology: Power, Temperature, Storage, Network, and AI
items.content_html: Benchmark Pi power, temperature, boot time, storage, network, and AI reproducibly. Capture hardware and software context, raw data, and failure states.

items.title: Raspberry Pi Connect Remote Updates: Complete Trixie Guide
items.content_html: Deploy Raspberry Pi Connect remote updates on Trixie. Build signed-checksum script artefacts, test staged rollouts, inspect OTA logs, and plan A/B recovery.

items.title: Build a Raspberry Pi LoRaWAN Gateway with ChirpStack
items.content_html: Build a LoRaWAN gateway with an SX1302 concentrator and ChirpStack Gateway OS. Select the legal band, register devices, secure MQTT, and measure range.

items.title: Raspberry Pi Pico 2 W and RP2350 Getting Started Guide
items.content_html: Start with Raspberry Pi Pico 2 W and RP2350 using MicroPython. Compare Pico W, flash firmware, connect Wi-Fi securely, test GPIO, benchmark, and fix errors.

items.title: Raspberry Pi Touch Display 2: 5, 7, and 10-Inch Comparison and Setup
items.content_html: Compare Raspberry Pi Touch Display 2 in 5, 7, and 10 inches. Check Pi compatibility, connect DSI and power safely, rotate the desktop, and test touch input.

items.title: Raspberry Pi AI Accelerator Comparison: AI Camera vs Coral vs Hailo
items.content_html: Compare Raspberry Pi AI inference options: CPU, AI Camera, Coral USB, AI HAT+, and AI HAT+ 2 by workloads, software, power, cost, and model support.

items.title: Raspberry Pi AI HAT Plus 2 Complete Guide: Local LLMs and VLMs
items.content_html: Run local LLMs and VLMs on Raspberry Pi 5 with AI HAT+ 2, Hailo-10H, hailo-ollama, Open WebUI, model setup, API tests, and troubleshooting.

items.title: Run Ultralytics YOLO on Raspberry Pi with OpenVINO
items.content_html: Run Ultralytics YOLO with OpenVINO on Raspberry Pi 4 or 5. Install Arm64 wheels, export models, enable caching, benchmark latency and FPS, and deploy safely.

items.title: Raspberry Pi Camera Setup and Troubleshooting: rpicam and Picamera2
items.content_html: Set up and troubleshoot Raspberry Pi Camera Module 3, HQ Camera, and AI Camera on current Raspberry Pi OS using rpicam-apps and Picamera2.

items.title: Raspberry Pi Connect Complete Guide: Secure Browser-Based Remote Access
items.content_html: Raspberry Pi Connect Complete Guide: Secure Browser-Based Remote Access. Follow Raspberry Pi setup, configuration, best practices, and troubleshooting steps.

items.title: Raspberry Pi OS Trixie Migration Guide: Safe Upgrade from Bookworm
items.content_html: Safely migrate a Raspberry Pi from Raspberry Pi OS Bookworm to Trixie. Back up Docker, services, SSH access, and data before a clean installation.

items.title: DevOps: Self-Hosted GitHub Actions Runner with Docker on Pi 5
items.content_html: Build a self-hosted GitHub Actions runner with Docker on Raspberry Pi 5. Automate ARM64 native builds and CI/CD pipelines in your homelab.

items.title: Edge AI: Running YOLOv8 with Vulkan GPU Acceleration via NCNN on Pi 5
items.content_html: Run YOLOv8 on Raspberry Pi 5 with Vulkan GPU acceleration. Compile ncnn framework and optimize object detection without external NPU hardware.

items.title: Network Mastery: WireGuard VPN Server with a Sleek Web UI via Docker
items.content_html: Deploy a WireGuard VPN server with a modern Web UI on Raspberry Pi using Docker Compose. Configure clients instantly using QR codes.

items.title: Smart Home: Advanced Home Assistant Dashboard Customization with CSS
items.content_html: Advanced guide to custom Home Assistant dashboards on Raspberry Pi. Install HACS and write CSS Lovelace cards for glassmorphism styles.

items.title: Cluster Mastery: Multi-Node K3s Cluster on Raspberry Pi 5
items.content_html: Build a multi-node Kubernetes cluster using K3s on Raspberry Pi 5. Configure cgroups, set up active Traefik ingress, and integrate with local DNS routing.
